market.summary: The KLCI has slipped below its 10-month moving average, so your rule that the monthly trend must be up fails. It sits near the bottom of its 3-month range (1,655–1,753), with foreign funds net selling RM1.01bn so far this month. The longer-term structure is intact (10-month MA still above the 20-month MA), so this looks like a pullback within a sideways year rather than a crash. Wait for the KLCI to close back above about 1,702 (the 10-month MA) before buying.

sectors.name: Solar & renewable energy (theme across sectors)
sectors.hot_reason: Hottest theme on Bursa this week. On Fri 18 Sep the Energy Transition and Water Transformation Ministry (PETRA) announced the CRESS Acceleration Package, and newly approved data centres must now use at least 30% renewable energy. Since then (week to 25 Sep): Samaiden +49.7%, Pekat +34.3%, Cypark +28.1%, Solarvest +23.0%. Solarvest and Samaiden hit record highs.
sectors.earnings_outlook: The main players are profitable and growing: Samaiden earnings +82%, Pekat +22%, Solarvest +15% year on year. HLIB expects Solarvest and Samaiden to win their first CRESS projects within 3 months, sizes the data-centre solar opportunity at RM9bn–36bn, and sees CRESS project returns of 9–11% vs 6–8% for earlier large-scale solar. HLIB raised targets: Solarvest RM4.85, Samaiden RM3.13.

sectors.hot_reason: The strongest sector on Bursa. AI data-centre spending is driving demand for chip testing, packaging and photonics (ViTrox, Inari, MPI, Unisem). Malaysian E&E exports jumped 46.4% year on year in April.
sectors.earnings_outlook: 95% of sector market cap is profitable; median earnings growth +27% year on year. Analysts say demand is outpacing the stronger ringgit. The main risk is valuation: many names trade above their 2021 peak P/Es (ViTrox about 87×).

notes: Rerun 25 Sep, 10pm with the new early-detection process. It scanned all 1,133 Bursa stocks (262 liquid: market cap RM300m+, average trading value RM500k+ a day) for bases near highs, quiet buying and breakouts on double volume, excluding anything overheated (RSI above 75, more than 25% above its 50-day MA, or up more than 25% in a week). It then linked setups to the catalysts coming up. None of the early candidates pass your P/E limit of 20; that limit screens out almost every stock in today's growth themes, so consider raising it to about 30 for themed stocks. Earlier today: added the solar theme after you flagged it. The 30% rule is verified but applies to newly approved data centres, announced 18 Sep with PETRA's CRESS Acceleration Package. The move was up to +50% in a week (Samaiden), not +100%.

catalysts.title: Budget 2027 tabled
catalysts.detail: The Prime Minister said the budget will be tabled in early October. Energy transition, data centres and infrastructure allocations are the usual market movers around budget day. Treat it as an event risk: stocks can run up before it and sell off on the day.
